project_info.name: Dra. Luzia de Cassia Nishida — Advocacia
project_info.target_audience: Pessoas físicas e jurídicas buscando assessoria jurídica de alta precisão, discrição, atendimento personalizado e alta taxa de êxito em São Paulo/Brasil.
project_info.design_level: Awwwards Site-of-the-Day Level (Kinetic Editorial & Corporate Luxury)

theme_strategy.visual_vibe: Sóbrio, solene, artesanal e contemporâneo. Fundo escuro profundo estilo ardósia/ônix com detalhes em Ouro Champanhe, Marfim e Verde Mosaico Profundo. Tipografia editorial dramática, recortes de revistas jurídicas de alto padrão e micro-interações suaves.

headings.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif font-semibold tracking-tight text-[#F5F3EF] leading-[1.1]
headings.h2: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-serif font-medium tracking-tight text-[#F5F3EF] leading-[1.15]

mono_accents.eyebrow: text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.25em] font-mono font-medium text-[#C5A059]

key_components_structure.name: NavigationHeader
key_components_structure.description: Fixed glassmorphism header with Dra. Luzia logo, OAB badge tag, navigation links (Sobre, Atuação, Galeria, Depoimentos, Contato), and a primary 'Agendar Consulta' CTA button.

key_components_structure.name: KineticHero
key_components_structure.description: Signature entry moment with line-by-line reveal animation (Framer Motion masked reveal). Contains lawyer executive portrait with gold trim, 3D CSS floating balance/legal emblem card, authority statistics counter, and dual CTAs.

key_components_structure.name: EditorialMarquee
key_components_structure.description: Slow, smooth drifting marquee ribbon built with custom CSS / framer-motion featuring core legal principles separated by gold rhombuses.
features: Low-contrast gold text on deep onyx background

key_components_structure.name: ManifestoSection
key_components_structure.description: Numbered chapters style ('Capítulo 01: Rigor Técnico', 'Capítulo 02: Atendimento Sob Medida', 'Capítulo 03: Resultados & Ética'). Includes Dra. Luzia's biography, academic background, OAB registration detail, and signature.

key_components_structure.name: PracticeAreasBento
key_components_structure.description: Asymmetric Bento Grid showcasing core legal services: Direito Civil, Família e Sucessões, Direito Empresarial, Imobiliário, Contratos & Preventivo.
features: Interactive expandable drawer/modal for detailed scope

key_components_structure.name: RealOfficeGallery
key_components_structure.description: Interactive gallery showing authentic high-resolution photos of the law office interior, consultation rooms, library, and meeting space.

key_components_structure.name: ClientTestimonials
key_components_structure.description: Verified client reviews featuring ratings (5 stars), client names, case types, avatar photos, and verified badges.

key_components_structure.name: HoursAndMapSection
key_components_structure.description: Operating hours display (Seg a Sex 08h30 - 18h00) alongside a stylized dark dark-themed interactive map with location pin, address details, and direct Waze/Google Maps routing triggers.

key_components_structure.name: ContactAndWhatsAppCTA
key_components_structure.description: Dual conversion hub: Direct WhatsApp link with pre-filled message, direct telephone trigger, address, and interactive consultation request form with date picker.

key_components_structure.name: FooterSection
key_components_structure.description: Institutional footer with OAB regulatory disclaimers, quick links, emergency contact button, and back-to-top button.
features: OAB Code of Ethics compliance note

motion_and_effects.smooth_scroll: Lenis for React / Native smooth scroll handling
motion_and_effects.entrance_animations: Framer motion staggerChildren with y: 30 to y: 0, opacity: 0 to 1
motion_and_effects.masked_text_reveal: Overflow-hidden wrapper with inner motion span sliding up
motion_and_effects.hover_effects: Border glow transition, subtle lift (translate-y-1), background tint shift
motion_and_effects.parallax_card: Framer Motion mouse coordinate tilt tracking on Hero visual card

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a stunning, complete single-page website for 'Dra. Luzia de Cassia Nishida — Advocacia'.
Ensure the design conveys high institutional authority, trust, and luxury with Cormorant Garamond font for headings and Plus Jakarta Sans for body.
Implement Framer Motion for line-by-line kinetic reveal in the Hero section, scroll reveal animations on all sections, and micro-interactions.

Include all required sections: Hero, Marquee, About/Manifesto (numbered chapters), Bento practice areas grid, Gallery with office photos, Client testimonials, Business hours + styled dark map, Contact with WhatsApp integration + form, and Footer.
Add test IDs (`data-testid`) to all interactive buttons, inputs, links, and key cards.
Ensure response forms trigger toasts using Sonner.
Maintain strict Portuguese (Brasil) throughout all copy.
